import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4.2))
ax.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 7)
ax.axis('off')

# Colors (Okabe-Ito)
C_GRAY = '#999999'
C_BLUE = '#56B4E9'
C_ORANGE = '#E69F00'
C_GREEN = '#009E73'
C_BG_INPUT = '#F0F0F0'
C_BG_EXEC = '#E8E8E8'
C_BG_TRACE = '#DDEEFF'

def rounded_box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, fc='white', ec='#333333', lw=1.2,
                fontsize=10, fontweight='normal', text_color='black',
                subtext=None, subtext_size=8):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
                         facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
                         transform=ax.transData, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if subtext:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2 + 0.18, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color, zorder=3)
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2 - 0.25, subtext, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=subtext_size, color='#555555', zorder=3)
    else:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color, zorder=3)
    return box

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color='#555555', lw=1.5):
    ar = FancyArrowPatch((x1, y1), (x2, y2),
                         arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=14,
                         color=color, linewidth=lw, zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(ar)

# === Left: Input box ===
rounded_box(ax, 0.3, 2.7, 2.0, 1.6, "Code\n+ Test Input",
            fc=C_BG_INPUT, ec='#888888', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# === Arrow to Execution ===
arrow(ax, 2.35, 3.5, 3.3, 3.5)

# === Execution box ===
rounded_box(ax, 3.3, 2.9, 1.8, 1.2, "Execution",
            fc=C_BG_EXEC, ec='#888888', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# === Arrow to Full Raw Trace ===
arrow(ax, 5.15, 3.5, 6.2, 3.5)

# === Full Raw Trace box ===
rounded_box(ax, 6.2, 2.7, 2.2, 1.6, "Full Raw\nTrace",
            fc=C_BG_TRACE, ec='#4488AA', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# === Four branch boxes on the right ===
branch_x = 10.5
branch_w = 3.8
branch_h = 1.05

branches = [
    {"y": 5.55, "label": "No Trace", "sublabel": "(baseline — no trace used)",
     "color": C_GRAY, "acc": "75.1%", "lw": 1.2, "highlight": False},
    {"y": 4.25, "label": "Full Trace", "sublabel": "(complete line-by-line trace)",
     "color": C_BLUE, "acc": "81.8%", "lw": 1.2, "highlight": False},
    {"y": 2.95, "label": "VOTA", "sublabel": "Exception + Assert-Point + Loop",
     "color": C_ORANGE, "acc": "99.4%", "lw": 1.2, "highlight": False},
    {"y": 1.65, "label": "Exception Only", "sublabel": "(only exception events)",
     "color": C_GREEN, "acc": "99.8%", "lw": 2.8, "highlight": True},
]

trace_cx = 6.2 + 2.2  # right edge of Full Raw Trace
trace_cy = 3.5

for b in branches:
    fc_light = matplotlib.colors.to_rgba(b["color"], alpha=0.12)
    box = rounded_box(ax, branch_x, b["y"], branch_w, branch_h,
                      b["label"], fc=fc_light, ec=b["color"],
                      lw=b["lw"], fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold',
                      subtext=b["sublabel"], subtext_size=8)

    # Accuracy label to the right
    acc_x = branch_x + branch_w + 0.15
    acc_y = b["y"] + branch_h / 2
    fw = 'bold' if b["highlight"] else 'normal'
    fs = 11 if b["highlight"] else 10
    ax.text(acc_x, acc_y, b["acc"], ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw, color=b["color"], zorder=3)

    # Star for headline result
    if b["highlight"]:
        ax.text(branch_x - 0.22, b["y"] + branch_h/2, "★",
                ha='right', va='center', fontsize=12, color=b["color"], zorder=3)

    # Arrow from Full Raw Trace to branch
    target_y = b["y"] + branch_h / 2
    arrow(ax, trace_cx, trace_cy, branch_x - 0.05, target_y, color=b["color"], lw=1.3)

# No Trace: dashed arrow from Input directly (bypass trace)
# Draw a curved path from input box to no_trace box
no_trace_y = branches[0]["y"] + branches[0]["branch_h"] / 2 if hasattr(branches[0], 'branch_h') else branches[0]["y"] + branch_h / 2
ar_nt = FancyArrowPatch((1.3, 4.3), (branch_x - 0.05, no_trace_y),
                         arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=14,
                         color=C_GRAY, linewidth=1.3, linestyle='dashed',
                         connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.25', zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(ar_nt)

# Bottom annotation
ax.text(8.0, 0.65, "Accuracy: Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B, seed=42, N=1190",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#777777',
        style='italic', zorder=3)

out_dir = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_4/projects/trace-verdict-study/figures/paper"
fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig1_trace_overview.pdf", format='pdf')
fig.savefig(f"{out_dir}/fig1_trace_overview.png", format='png')
plt.close()
print("Done.")
